messages.subject: Extract color values?
parts:
I recently read this post on Learning R:
http://learnr.wordpress.com/2010/01/26/ggplot2-quick-heatmap-plotting/

I really like this heatmap, but was wondering how to get the color
information for each tile?

Here's some dummy code if that would help:

> library(ggplot2)
> foo = read.table('foo.txt', header=T)
> foomelt = melt(foo)
Using COG as id variables
> ggplot(foomelt, aes(x=COG, y=variable, fill=value)) + geom_tile() + scale_fill_gradient(low='white', high='steelblue')


Thanks guys.

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: RE: Extract color values?
parts:
Hi Zachwill,

I think that you should take a look on colorRamp;

f <- colorRampPalette(c('white', 'steelblue'), space = 'rgb', interpolate =
'linear') # default in scale_fill_gradient

require(graphics)
filled.contour(volcano, color.palette = f)

f(5) # e.g. only five levels

hope this helps,
fernando
